description: Change which other projects' issues a project's sprints take, as the board menu's «🤝 Sprints take issues from…» does. Either 'projects' — the whole list you want, which replaces the one you see — or 'add' and/or 'remove' — changes to it. A listed project you cannot open is kept whatever you pass. All or nothing: when any project is refused, nothing changes and 'projects' says why for each (unknown, the project itself, a mirrored project, one you cannot write in). A project taken off keeps its issues in the sprints they already lie in until those end; from then on, none of its issues go in. Every change is a line in the journal of both projects under your name. Only the project's lead or an administrator may change it, and only a project they can write in may be added.

add.description: Projects to add to the list, by key.

projectKey.description: The project whose sprints take the issues (the host), e.g. 'CORE'.

projects.description: The whole list, by key: ['MOBILE', 'WEB']; [] takes every project you can see off it. Leave out to use 'add' / 'remove'.

remove.description: Projects to take off the list, by key.
